svg.text: 08_Jordanian_Unemployment_Truth · DoS Labour Force Survey · Jordanian citizens 15+
Unemployed Jordanians by governorate, 2025 annual. Derived from DoS PxWeb person counts (EMPALL1, EMPALL). Boundaries: geoBoundaries (CC BY 2.5). Spire positions: governorate capital cities.
Ground colour is the unemployment rate.
Spire height is the number of unemployed
Jordanians. The two tell different stories.
Amman · rate 19.1% · 36% of the national total
Amman, Irbid and Zarqa hold 7 in 10 of the unemployed
Rates are derived annual 2025: unemployed ÷ (unemployed + employed), DoS counts. Not a DoS-published governorate rate.
